installed_languages.markdownDescription: Which Sublime scopes TreeSitter actively parses and tracks, not which languages are available: `tree_sitter_language_pack` can fetch and cache any of its ~370 languages on demand regardless of this list. Run `TreeSitter: Install Language` / `TreeSitter: Remove Language` to manage this list

scope_to_language_name.markdownDescription: Override or extend which language to use for which Sublime Text scope, see [src/utils.py](https://github.com/sublime-treesitter/TreeSitter/blob/main/src/utils.py)

scope_to_queries_name.markdownDescription: Override or extend which which queries to use for which Sublime Text scope

language_name_to_debounce_ms.markdownDescription: Debounce parsing for parsers that are slow

queries_path.markdownDescription: Path to queries files for all languages

file_ignore_patterns.markdownDescription: If file matches any of these regex patterns, ignore it (useful for e.g. files that cause Tree-sitter parse errors)

debug.markdownDescription: Enable debug logging and assertions; has non-zero performance cost, for developers only
